title: Author + implement PROP-053-rev2: batched fix for the 6 audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js defects flagged by curmudgeon review
background:
Curmudgeon's review at monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/audit-exp-tracker-gaps.c1.json found 6 defects in the PROP-053 implementation tinker shipped on 2026-05-24. All 6 were filed as ISSs on 2026-06-01T05:12Z and have sat in pending-human since (2 critical, 3 major, 1 moderate). Operator triaged them on 2026-06-01 as 'Group C' and intended to file a single tinker directive but did not — surfacing 2026-06-02 from a follow-up question about open critical findings.

The 6 defects all touch the same trio of artifacts (script + reference doc + spec) and are tightly coupled, so a single PROP-053-rev2 fix is the cleanest path rather than 6 separate fixes:

  ISS-2434 [CRITICAL] script: missing archive JSONL read. Doesn't ingest monitor/analyst/expansion-tracker-archive.jsonl (423 entries, 372 distinct IDs under PROP-022 phase 4). Reports 380 phantom 'missing' EXPs.
  ISS-2435 [CRITICAL] script: missing no_trace category (PROP-053 spec required 4 categories, only 3 implemented). 41 of 94 missing IDs were genuine no_trace bulk-reservations now mis-categorized.
  ISS-2436 [MAJOR] reference doc monitor/prompts/reference/expansion-tracker-gap-semantics.md canonizes the archive-blind bug as correct behavior. Says 'EXP-001 through ~EXP-450 = pre-tracker, benign' — there is no pre-tracker era. Need to rewrite the doc to match reality (tracker always existed; PROP-022 phase 4 split it into live+archive).
  ISS-2437 [MAJOR] output JSON schema mismatch: PROP-053 spec, the shipped script, and expansion-tracker-gap-semantics.md ref doc all describe different output schemas. Spec requires top-level fields total_slots / present / missing_total / missing_ranges / missing_in_context; script ships different fields. Trio must agree.
  ISS-2438 [MAJOR] PROP-053 spec's implementation_note misdescribes the shipped script: claims --summary and --json-output flags exist (they do not), omits the archive-blind behavior as a documented limitation. Misleads future maintainers.
  ISS-2440 [MODERATE] structure-integrity.md edit was the third deliverable of PROP-053 but never shipped. The reference doc Section 4 describes the edit: report MODERATE when orphan_file gaps > 5, otherwise INFO. Integrity check currently does not flag orphan gaps at all.

This is meta-work — fixing a script that fixes the tracker audit. Importance: the integrity-side audit can't trust orphan-gap counts until 2434+2435 are fixed (the 380 phantom orphans pollute every integrity report). 2436 actively misleads anyone reading the reference doc. 2437/2438 are documentation-vs-code mismatches that block future tinker self-applies from this script.

operator_decision.rationale: All 6 defects touch the same artifact trio (script + ref doc + PROP-053 spec + structure-integrity.md). Splitting into 6 separate fixes would multiply review/integration overhead with no benefit. Tinker authored the original PROP-053 work and has full context. A single PROP-053-rev2 with all 6 fixes batched is the right shape.

requested_work: Step 1 — Read curmudgeon's review at monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/audit-exp-tracker-gaps.c1.json end-to-end. Confirm understanding of all 6 holes and their proposed fixes. If any of the curmudgeon's proposed fixes look wrong or incomplete, raise as a Q-OP in the PROP rather than implementing the wrong fix.

Step 2 — Read the 4 affected artifacts in their current state:
  (a) monitor/scripts/audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js (the script with the bugs)
  (b) monitor/prompts/reference/expansion-tracker-gap-semantics.md (the ref doc that canonizes the bug)
  (c) monitor/tinker/proposals/PROP-053-*.json (the original spec — find by glob, it's PROP-053-something-gap-audit)
  (d) monitor/prompts/structure-integrity.md (the integrity prompt that should have had the orphan-gap severity edit shipped)

Step 3 — Author monitor/tinker/proposals/PROP-053-rev2-audit-script-fix.json. Required sections: title, problem_statement (cite this directive + the 6 ISS IDs + the curmudgeon review path), proposed_fixes (one entry per ISS with file/lines/before/after), Q-OPs if any (e.g. operator preference on the no_trace category's downstream classification — does it count as a 'real' gap or a 'benign' one for severity-reporting?), verification_pattern (greps + a dry-run of the fixed script against current data showing the 380 phantom orphans are gone), files_touched list (4 files), estimated_loc per file.

Step 4 — Operator pre-approves the following design directions; tinker should adopt unless something blocks:
  (a) ISS-2434/2435 script fixes: prefer additive logic (add archive read + no_trace classifier) rather than restructuring the existing 3-category code path. Keep the existing categories' behavior intact.
  (b) ISS-2436 doc rewrite: be honest about the PROP-022 phase-4 history. Don't paper over the original design assumption — say what the doc previously claimed, why that was wrong, and what the correct semantics are.
  (c) ISS-2437 schema alignment: pick the spec's schema as canonical (total_slots / present / missing_total / missing_ranges / missing_in_context); update script and ref doc to match, NOT the other way around. The spec is the longest-lived artifact and was reviewed by operator at authoring time.
  (d) ISS-2438 impl_note: rewrite to describe what the script ACTUALLY does (not what it was supposed to do). If --summary and --json-output flags are valuable to add, that's a separate scope; for rev2 just document accurate behavior.
  (e) ISS-2440 structure-integrity.md edit: ship the edit as PROP-053-rev2's Step C — the prompt-level integration of the orphan-gap severity reporting. Use the threshold from the ref doc Section 4 (MODERATE when orphan_file > 5, INFO otherwise) unless tinker has a stronger proposal.

Step 5 — Tinker self-applies per the PROP-070/072/073 pattern: write the proposal, then implement in the SAME run if (a) operator pre-approvals above are sufficient, (b) total implementation is <~80 lines across the 4 files, (c) verification_pattern passes including the dry-run-of-fixed-script test. Hold for operator review if Q-OPs arise that aren't pre-answered.

Step 6 — Validation: after the fix, run the fixed audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js against the current expansion-tracker.json + expansion-tracker-archive.jsonl. Expected outcomes documented in the PROP file's 'post-deployment canary' section:
  - 380 phantom orphan_file entries DROP to 0 (or whatever count remains after archive read is wired)
  - no_trace category populates with the bulk-reservation IDs
  - output JSON matches spec's schema (total_slots, present, missing_total, missing_ranges, missing_in_context as top-level fields)
  - integrity check on next daily run reports orphan-gap severity correctly per the new structure-integrity.md edit

Step 7 — Close all 6 ISSs (2434, 2435, 2436, 2437, 2438, 2440) as 'fixed' with closure_resolution citing PROP-053-rev2 + this directive + the implementation commit. Move from open-issues.json to closed-issues.json, append closure-ledger.jsonl. (Tinker can do this directly in its own work clone — same pattern as decider's auto-close on integration.)

Step 8 — Lifecycle: flip PROP-053-rev2.json status='implemented' with implementation_commit + implementation_at + implementation_run. Flip this directive to status='completed' with prop_id_implemented='PROP-053-rev2'. Also flip the ORIGINAL PROP-053 to status='superseded-by-rev2' with superseded_at and superseded_by_prop set.
Step 9 — Manually copy the 4 edited files to FUSE so next-cycle agents see the fixed code/doc/prompt. dome-mirror will propagate within ~1h but manual sync is the safe bootstrap path.
non_goals: Do NOT drop the audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js script entirely or rewrite from scratch. The 3 working categories (orphan_file, tracker_referenced_no_file, mentioned_only) are sound; only add archive read + no_trace category, and align the output schema.
Do NOT change the PROP-053 specification's required output fields. The spec is canonical (per Step 4c). Align script and ref doc to it.

Do NOT add new CLI flags (--summary, --json-output) in rev2 even though ISS-2438 mentions the impl_note falsely claims they exist. Just fix the impl_note to describe what the script DOES, not what it CLAIMS. New flags = separate scope.
Do NOT touch monitor/prompts/structure-integrity.md beyond shipping the orphan-gap severity edit from PROP-053's original Section 4 ref-doc plan. Other integrity-prompt work is out of scope.
Do NOT re-trigger an integrity audit run as part of this directive — let the next daily integrity cycle (cron 02:00 UTC) pick up the fix naturally and verify in its own report.
Do NOT renumber the existing PROP-053 to PROP-NNN; use the rev-suffix pattern (PROP-053-rev2) since the parent proposal is a known artifact and we want the lineage clear.

expected_output: (1) monitor/tinker/proposals/PROP-053-rev2-audit-script-fix.json with status='implemented'. (2) Edits to monitor/scripts/audit-exp-tracker-gaps.js (script fixes for ISS-2434/2435 + schema alignment for ISS-2437). (3) Edit to monitor/prompts/reference/expansion-tracker-gap-semantics.md (rewrite for ISS-2436 + schema alignment for ISS-2437). (4) Edit to monitor/prompts/structure-integrity.md (orphan-gap severity edit for ISS-2440). (5) Edit to PROP-053-*.json (impl_note rewrite for ISS-2438 + status='superseded-by-rev2'). (6) 6 ISSs closed in open/closed/ledger files. (7) This directive at status='completed'. (8) Original PROP-053 at status='superseded-by-rev2'. (9) 4 edited files FUSE-synced.
estimated_effort: ~90-120 min Opus. The 4 fixes are surgical individually but tightly coupled — schema alignment in (c) touches 3 files at once. Validation dry-run (Step 6) is the longest single step (~15 min). Lifecycle bookkeeping (~10 min). PROP authoring (~20 min).
priority_note: HIGH — 2 criticals have been open for >24h, plus the 380-phantom-orphan pollution corrupts every integrity report. Worth shipping in the next 1-2 tinker runs.
